dashboard.label: Excel Export Demo
dashboard.description: Click a button to download the results as a native .xlsx file instead of a CSV.

search.query: | makeresults count=250 | streamstats count AS n | eval host="web-0".(n%5+1), status=case(n%10==0,500, n%7==0,404, true(),200), bytes=random()%100000, response_ms=round((random()%2000)/10,1), user_id=substr("000000".n,-6), _time=_time-(n*60) | table _time host status bytes response_ms user_id

html.p: The first button exports the full result set of search_export (250 rows). The second one builds a workbook with two sheets, one per search. Both call the /services/excel_export endpoint of the app.

panel.title: Export with a plain link (no JavaScript)

html.p: A link to the endpoint is enough: it reuses the job of search_export through the $$export_sid$$ token set in <done>.

search.query: | table _time host status bytes response_ms user_id
| stats count AS events, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, avg(response_ms) AS avg_response_ms by host | eval avg_response_ms=round(avg_response_ms,1) | sort host
